title: Zip Code Loses Its Leading Zero
description:
`normalize_zip_code(zip_str)` should return a 5-digit zip code string, unchanged apart from stripping whitespace. Right now zip codes that start with a `0` (common in the northeastern US) come back shortened. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Function signature**
`normalize_zip_code(zip_str: str) -> str`

**Example**
`normalize_zip_code(" 02139 ")` -> `"02139"`.
